incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> auth-proxy: unusual 401 burst from narrow IP range (edge region). Severity: P1
Priya Kaur: saw the page. spikes started ~08:12 UTC. Routers show hit on /v1/ingest and /v1/session-check
Samir Patel: oncall here, taking lead. labeling as security-triage. collecting impact now. @pagerduty-bot who is primary? :raised_hand:
pagerduty-bot: Primary: Samir Patel (now). Secondary: Alex Chen. Escalation window 15m.
Alex Chen: adding raw log tail: ```
[08:13:02] edge-us-east -> auth-proxy 401 "GET /v1/ingest" src=34.210.123.45 ua="thin-client/1.2"
[08:13:03] edge-us-east -> auth-proxy 401 "POST /v1/session-check" src=34.210.123.45 ua="thin-client/1.2"
[08:13:10] edge-us-east -> auth-proxy 200 "GET /health" src=52.12.11.11 ua="monitor/1.0"
```
Alex Chen: note: 401s are high but token introspect service returns 200 for same tokens from other IPs. suggests source-specific auth failures.
Mateo Ruiz: checking router/edge ACLs and rate-limits. pulling geo + ASN info for 34.210.123.45. ETA 5m.
Jamie Park: security — flagging this as suspicious probe. no evidence of successful token use yet. Do we see any data-plane requests with 200s containing customer IDs from that IP?
Priya Kaur: quick scan of recent 5m: no 200s to user-data endpoints from that IP. mostly 401/403.
Samir Patel: good. actions: 1) rate-limit + temporary block on src IPs 2) rotate service token used by edge-auth-proxy (if compromised) 3) create ticket for legal if PII risk + update customers if needed. Assigning tasks: Alex take rotate token, Mateo apply ACLs, Jamie lead for risk assessment.
Alex Chen: prepping rotation. which token? edge-auth-proxy svcacct (edge-ingest-reader). I'll stage new key in KMS and update deployment with zero-downtime rolling restart. Command outline: ```
# create new key in KMS
aws kms create-key --description "ephemeral rotate edge-ingest-reader"
# update secret
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id edge/edge-ingest-reader --secret-string '{"token":"NEW_TOKEN"}'
# trigger canary deploy
kubectl set env deployment/auth-proxy AUTH_TOKEN=NEW_TOKEN -n infra --record
```
Alex Chen: ETA 8m for key in KMS, 12m for canary to show healthy.
Mateo Ruiz: applying edge ACL: ```
# block single offending ip range
iptables -A INPUT -s 34.210.123.45/32 -j DROP
# apply at edge LB rule (fast)
```
Mateo Ruiz: ACL pushed at edge LB, seeing drop counts incrementing. 401 rate down 80% from that IP.
Jamie Park: running quick token-use grep to look for anomalies across services. if we rotate, preserve old token with short TTL to avoid blackholing legitimate requests.
Samir Patel: coordinate rotation window. Alex please create short-lived backfill policy: old token valid for 5m after new key active, then revoke. Post exact revoke command here before running.
Alex Chen: will do. creating support ticket INS-210987 now and attaching logs. Also tagging runbook: security/rotate-service-token v2.
Alex Chen: revoke plan: ```
# after canary ok
kubectl set env deployment/auth-proxy AUTH_TOKEN=NEW_TOKEN -n infra --record
sleep 300
# revoke old secret
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id edge/edge-ingest-reader --secret-string '{"token":"NEW_TOKEN"}' --version-stages '["AWSCURRENT"]'
# invalidate caches
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/kv-cache/invalidate -d '{"service":"auth-proxy"}'
```
Priya Kaur: FYI customer-facing risk minimal so far — no confirmed token reuse. recommend holding off on external comms until legal signs off.
Legal - Nora: looped in. please add initial summary + artifacts to INS-210987. I'll review and advise on notification thresholds.
Jamie Park: running background grep for access patterns to S3/artifacts. nothing abnormal yet. will escalate if we see 200s with data payloads referencing customer IDs.
Samir Patel: update on status: ACL applied (Mateo), canary deploy in progress (Alex). Monitoring for error rate and customer impact.
Alex Chen: canary healthy at 2 nodes, no 5xx, auth latency unchanged. switching 50% traffic to new token.
Priya Kaur: metrics: auth failure rate cluster-wide dropped 27% in last 3m. no user-error increase reported in external metrics.
Jamie Park: still no data exfil signals. going to continue 30m watch and run a deeper audit on token introspection logs.
Samir Patel: agreed. leave incident as triage, not escalating to full customer notice for now. Next check-in in 15m. tagging @incident-bot to keep timeline.
incident-bot: Incident INS-210987 updated: action taken (edge ACL, service token rotation partial). status: monitoring. assigned owners: Samir Patel (lead), Alex Chen (rotate), Mateo Ruiz (ACL), Jamie Park (sec).
Alex Chen: completed rotation and old token revoked after 5m hold. rolling restart finished. all auth-proxy pods reporting new token and passing health checks.
Mateo Ruiz: edge LB drop rule removed for 34.210.123.45 after 25m, no further hits.
Priya Kaur: running post-mortem checklist: short description, timeline, actions, follow-ups (increase WAF rules, expand token rotation playbook). I'll draft and share.
Legal - Nora: reviewed artifacts, no PII exposure detected. recommend monitoring for 72h, no external notice required. I'll update ticket with legal sign-off.
Samir Patel: closing loop: incident moved to resolved->monitoring. great run. shoutout to the quick ACL + rotation combo. :trophy:
Priya Kaur: thanks all — will drop draft postmortem in INS-210987 and assign follow-ups.
incident-bot: Incident INS-210987 status -> RESOLVED (monitoring). total incident window ~00:44:00.
